title: Astronomy lesson from sky-survey data (SDSS/Gaia, educator-reviewed)
context: SDSS and Gaia sky-survey data are publicly available but their release terms vary by data release — some may be non-commercial. A classroom astronomy lesson built from verified sky-survey data makes real scientific datasets accessible to educators and students. NC terms must be handled explicitly: carry the NC label or exclude the source, never launder NC data into a permissive output. An astronomer or educator domain reviewer is required.
objective: Build a classroom astronomy lesson from sky-survey data (SDSS or Gaia, per-release license verified), with educator/astronomer domain review, passing gate-003 with NC handling, and accessible output.
acceptanceCriteria: Gate-003 PASS: SDSS/Gaia release terms verified to permit educational reuse; NC terms handled (carry NC label or exclude source) — never laundered into a permissive output; required SDSS/Gaia acknowledgment text included.
Classroom lesson built from survey data includes accurate astronomy, a Methodology Card, and a Sources-&-limits panel with data vintage; an astronomer or educator domain reviewer signs off.
Accessibility pass (WCAG 2.2 AA, reading grade <= 8) signed off.
Output licensed CC-BY-4.0 (or NC-labelled if a release requires it); license reviewer sign-off obtained.
Lesson is ready for classroom use and clearly framed as education, not professional advice.
resources: PLAN.md — Data, licensing & compliance (SDSS/Gaia row and NC handling)
output: A classroom astronomy lesson (committed document + static visualisation + Methodology Card + gate artifact + astronomer/educator sign-off + accessibility sign-off).
